scope: Reference-informed automated signal annotation demonstration. Not a blind listening submission.
guideline: Speech annotation guide 1.1; perceptual fields require listening.
review_status: Automated measurements complete; listening review pending

perceptual_annotation.reason: No listening review performed. Reference provenance is separate from perceived origin.
perceptual_annotation.escalation: Listen at original speed; confirm intelligibility and channel interference, review quiet intervals, and check whether the 30-second crop truncates a word. Record only cues actually heard.

reference.reference_origin_basis: Corpus provenance, not a listening or detector verdict
reference.processing: First 30 seconds, unmodified PCM samples; no normalization, denoising, or splicing.
reference.attribution: LibriSpeech corpus, Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur. Excerpt cropped to 30 seconds.
reference.privacy: Public audiobook excerpt; no personal workstation paths or reviewer identifiers included. Not a guarantee that spoken fiction contains no names.

source_measurements.representation: decoded source channels; no mixing, resampling or normalization
limitations: Measures decoded samples; decoder precision and lossy-codec history remain relevant.
Sample peak is not oversampled true peak; near-full-scale samples do not prove clipping.
Null dB values indicate zero energy or an undefined ratio, not missing samples.
Mixdown attenuation describes channel interaction, not tampering or synthetic speech.
